title: Wag Gets the Wet Wig
lines: Meg has a big pup. He is Wag.
Wag can run. Wag can win!
Meg has a red wig on. It is fun.
Wag wags. Wag hits the wig!
The wig got in a wet bog.
The wig is wet. Meg is sad.
Wag runs in. Wag gets the wig.
Meg sets the wig in the hot sun.
Wag sits. Meg sits. We can not run.
The wig is not wet. Meg hugs Wag.

questions.ask: How did the wig get wet?
questions.listenFor: Wag hit it and it went in the bog. Two steps, so it is fine if your child needs to look back at the lines to get both.

questions.ask: What did Meg do to dry the wig?
questions.listenFor: She set it in the hot sun. It is said in the story. If they guess, have them find the line with the word sun in it.

questions.ask: Do you think Meg should be mad at Wag? Tell me why or why not.
questions.listenFor: There is no right answer. Listen for a reason - Wag did not mean it, or Wag went in and got the wig back. Push gently for the because.
